description:
IDE for your code

Get ready for Version Beta, the ultimate 36-hour hackathon organized by ISTE SC MANIT! This is your chance to break away from the ordinary and dive into an exciting world of innovation, collaboration, and problem-solving.

With expert-led guidance and a dynamic environment, you’ll learn, grow, and connect with tech enthusiasts from across India. Plus, with amazing rewards and cash prizes up for grabs, this is an experience you won't want to miss!

💡 Important: Ideation Phase & Registration Process
Please note that our Registration and Ideation Phase are running simultaneously, ending on October 23rd.

Since Devfolio requires every participant to register individually before forming a team on the platform, we are collecting your project ideas directly in the application form.

How to submit your idea:

Step 1: Prepare your team's Ideation PPT (using Google Slides, Canva, or Google Drive).

Step 2: Ensure the access permissions are set to "Anyone with the link can view" (Restricted links will be disqualified).

Step 3: When filling out the Devfolio application form, paste this link into the required PPT submission field.

Team Leaders: Please submit the valid, working link to your presentation.

Team Members: You must also fill out the application individually. You can either paste the exact same link as your team leader or type "NA" in the field.
